verdict.rationale: Bento states that every prompt, skill, and model change is versioned, diffable, and reversible, with regressions traceable to the change that caused them [15]. Skills and rules live in the user's repo as Markdown/YAML, so they can be reviewed and rolled back through normal source control [16]. Fixes ship in shadow mode and promote from candidate only after proving themselves, with releases scored before rollout [11][12][14], which adds a review gate. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the rollback mechanism and review workflow (UI/CLI commands), any version history for signals and alert rules (only an in-place `signals update` is documented), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
